_comment: Copy to config.json (or point BELPHEGOR_CONFIG at another path). Only database and skill_dir live here; LLM and other settings come from environment variables or the UI.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: BELPHEGOR_PG_DSN, then this file. Use either the separate fields below, or one complete connection string in database.dsn (then the separate fields are ignored).
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root: one subdirectory per skill, each with a SKILL.md. Precedence: BELPHEGOR_SKILL_DIR, then this field, then skills/ next to the executable.
